fields.label: Description
fields.value: Photograph caption dated February 8, 1960 reads "Winners in First Lutheran School's poster and slogan contest are, from left, Rick Keaton, best poster in grade 7-8 division; Brent Blake, slogan contest winner, Sandra Brown, grade 1, 2 and 3 division poster winner, and John Shaffer, grade 4, 5 and 6 division poster winner. Event was sponsored by Valley Dental Society and posters will be displayed Feb. 7-13." The school is in Van Nuys.
